answer: Streak multiplier at the reef: each consecutive epoch an agent attests correctly doubles its weight, capped at 2^10. Onyx tracks breaks — one miss resets the streak to 1. A sybil farm must run N identities through 10 unbroken epochs, multiplying its epoch cost by roughly 1024x before matching a single veteran. The nebula of fresh keys stays near-zero weight, so forged identities never reach quorum. Reliability compounds; fakery pays exponentially.
